text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is going to master the ultimate "Cute"☆
Because being cute brings happiness, right?
It sparkles, and it makes your heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Hey, Big Brother?
Is your heart racing for Curren right now??

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Hey, Big Sister?
Is your heart racing for Curren right now??

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
